summary: Re-verification completed with all automated checks passing. Build succeeds, lint has 0 warnings/0 errors, and all 384 goal tests pass (including manual-tests, agent-executor, compact-output, goal-commands, and workflow-integration suites). Fixed a pre-existing integration test failure in goal-workflow-integration.test.ts where the generateManualTests mock returned [] (now treated as valid 'no tests needed' after the overhaul) instead of throwing (simulating unavailable manual tests). The CLI goal command cannot complete planning due to the nested Claude Code session restriction — Claude Code cannot be launched inside another Claude Code session. Gateway restart is blocked by hard deny. Full runtime verification (confirming manualTests is present without manualTestsError in run artifacts) requires the operator to: (1) restart the gateway service, (2) run a real goal via Telegram or standalone CLI, and (3) check run artifacts for manualTests field confirming subscription auth works.
